name: Metamagic Rod, Still Spell
body:
Editor Note: This does not appear in Ultimate Equipment as it was previous claimed, ask your GM about using it. Note 2: Or, after an hour of reseach, in any other book, to this editor’s knowledge. This metamagic rod is being/was moved to 3rd Party Rods

Aura strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.; Price varies by specific type: lesser 3,000 gp, standard 11,000 gp, greater 24,500 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day as though using the Still Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Still Spell

Cost varies by specific type: Lesser 1,500 gp, Standard 5,500 gp, greater 12,250 gp

FYI: Lesser and Greater Metamagic Rods

Normal metamagic rods can be used with spells of 6th level or lower. Lesser rods can be used with spells of 3rd level or lower, while greater rods can be used with spells of 9th level or lower.
